input.change_text: Added conditional `if` field for hooks using permission rule syntax (e.g., `Bash(git *)`) to filter when they run, reducing process spawning overhead

output.subject: Conditional `if` field on hooks (permission rule syntax)
output.action_text: Add an `if` field to hook entries in settings.json using permission-rule syntax (e.g., `Bash(git *)`) to gate when they run in Claude Code 2.1.85+. Cuts process-spawn overhead for hooks that only care about a subset of tool calls; existing unconditional hooks unchanged.
